title: Design Landing Page Layout
description: Create the structure of the landing page using Next.js App Router conventions, ensuring a clean, responsive layout.
details: Implement the landing page at `app/page.tsx` (or `app/page.jsx` if using JS). Use semantic HTML5 elements for structure (header, main, footer). Ensure the layout is responsive and mobile-friendly. Plan for sections such as a hero area, product highlights, and call-to-action buttons. Use only black and white colors as per the requirements.
test_strategy: Verify the page renders at `/`, is responsive on mobile and desktop, and uses only black and white colors. Check for correct semantic structure and accessibility (e.g., headings, landmarks).

title: Integrate Shadcn UI Components
description: Incorporate Shadcn UI components for buttons and layout elements to ensure accessibility and design consistency.
details: Replace or enhance basic HTML elements (e.g., buttons, cards, headings) with Shadcn UI components where appropriate. Ensure all interactive elements (e.g., call-to-action buttons) use Shadcn UI for consistent styling and accessibility. Adjust Tailwind classes to enforce black and white color scheme.
test_strategy: Check that all interactive elements use Shadcn UI components and maintain accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA labels). Ensure color scheme remains black and white.

title: Apply Tailwind CSS 4 Styling
description: Style the landing page using Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes, enforcing a black and white color palette.
details: Use Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes to style all elements. Apply classes such as `bg-black`, `text-white`, `border-white`, etc., to achieve the required monochrome look. Ensure all backgrounds, text, and borders strictly adhere to the black and white palette. Remove or override any default Shadcn or Tailwind colors that introduce other hues.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the landing page to confirm only black and white colors are present. Use browser dev tools or accessibility tools to verify color contrast and palette compliance.

title: Add Calls to Action and Navigation Links
description: Implement prominent call-to-action buttons (Sign Up, Sign In) and navigation links using Shadcn UI components.
details: Add clear, accessible call-to-action buttons for 'Sign Up' and 'Sign In' in the header or hero section. Use Shadcn UI Button components styled with Tailwind for black/white appearance. Ensure navigation links are present and accessible. Link buttons to `/sign-up` and `/sign-in` routes.
test_strategy: Test that buttons are visible, accessible, and route correctly. Confirm keyboard navigation and ARIA labeling. Check that links use only black and white styling.
